[Section] Conclusion
[source_id=97] In this paper, we alleviate the severe data imbalance issue in NLP tasks. We propose to use dice loss in replacement of the standard cross-entropy loss, which performs as a soft version of F1 score. Using dice loss can help narrow the gap between training objectives and evaluation metrics. Empirically, we show that the proposed training objective leads to significant performance boost for part-of-speech, named entity recognition, machine reading comprehension and paraphrase identification tasks.
